an10.85:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Mahācundo Cetīsu viharati Sahajātiyaṃ.
an10.85:1.2: Tatra kho āyasmā Mahācundo bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an10.85:1.4: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahācundassa paccassosuṃ.
an10.85:2.1: Idhāvuso bhikkhu katthī hoti vikatthī adhigamesu
an10.85:2.2: ‘ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi, ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pī' ti.
an10.85:3.1: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo samanuyuñjati samanugāhati samanubhāsati.
an10.85:3.2: So Tathāgatena vā Tathāgatasāvakena vā jhāyinā samāpattikusalena paracittakusalena paracittapariyāyakusalena samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno iriṇaṃ āpajjati, vijinaṃ āpajjati, anayaṃ āpajjati, vyasanaṃ āpajjati, anayavyasanaṃ āpajjati.
an10.85:4.1: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasikaroti:
an10.85:4.2: Kin nu kho ayam āyasmā katthī hoti vikatthī adhigamesu
an10.85:4.3: ‘ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pi . . . pe . . .
an10.85:4.4: ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjāmi pi vuṭṭhahāmi pī' ti?
an10.85:5.1: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti:
an10.85:6.1: Dīgharattaṃ kho ayam āyasmā khaṇḍakārī chiddakārī sabalakārī kammāsakārī na santatakārī na santatavuttī sīlesu.
an10.85:6.3: dussīlyaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:7.2: assaddhiyaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:8.1: Appassuto kho pana ayam āyasmā anācāro,
an10.85:8.2: appasaccaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:9.2: dovacassatā kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:10.2: pāpamittatā kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:11.2: kosajjaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:12.2: muṭṭhasaccaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:13.2: kuhanā kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:14.2: dubbharatā kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.85:15.2: duppaññatā kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ. 3.
an10.85:16.1: Seyyathā pi āvuso sahāyako sahāyakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya
an10.85:16.2: ‘yadā te samma dhanena dhanakaraṇīyaṃ assa, yācissasi maṃ dhanaṃ, dassāmi te dhanan' ti.
an10.85:16.3: So kismiñci-d-eva dhanakaraṇīye samuppanne sahāyako sahāyakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya ‘attho me samma dhanena, dehi me dhanan' ti.
an10.85:16.5: ‘tena hi samma idha khaṇāhī' ti. So tatra khaṇanto nādhigaccheyya.
an10.85:16.7: ‘alikaṃ maṃ samma avaca, tucchakaṃ maṃ samma avaca: idha khaṇāhī' ti.
an10.85:16.9: ‘nāhan taṃ samma alikaṃ avacaṃ, tucchakaṃ avacaṃ, tena hi samma idha khaṇāhī' ti.
an10.85:16.12: ‘alikaṃ maṃ samma avaca, tucchakaṃ maṃ samma avaca: idha khaṇāhī' ti.
